title: Expiry-Date Food-Waste Reducer
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level category=fridge
| eval days_to_expiry=round((expiry_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_expiry>=0 AND days_to_expiry<=3
| sort days_to_expiry
description: Flags fridge items about to expire so you eat them in time and cut food waste and its cost.
value: Use-it-up prompts turn forgotten leftovers into meals, saving money and reducing waste.
implementation: Ingest fridge inventory with expiry dates into `index=personal`; alert on items expiring soon.
visualization: Table of fridge items expiring within days.
grandmaExplanation: It flags food about to go off so you eat it in time, cutting waste and saving money.
